ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the right side of the figure is a D flip-flop module, the left input terminal is labeled D, below there is a CLK clock input, and the right-side outputs are Q and Q̅. The D input is driven by the output of the XOR gate on the left. One input of the XOR gate comes from the external signal X, and the other input is returned from the flip-flop's Q output through the upper feedback line. Reasoning: Since the next state of the D flip-flop equals its D input, Q_next = D. In the figure, D = X XOR Q, therefore Q_next = X ⊕ Q. When X = 0, Q_next = Q, and the output remains unchanged; when X = 1, Q_next = Q̅, and the output toggles. This is exactly the behavior of a T flip-flop, where the T input corresponds to X.
